recipeNotes: Copy this file into the app repo and replace each source path with a real UI capture.
Keep the first three screenshots focused on core value, high-intent search/action, and the strongest differentiator.
Every App Store screenshot should have a big bold headline, short benefit line, visible CTA pill, colorful branded background, and a large enough device capture to inspect the UI.
Use bright solid or lightly patterned backgrounds for App Store search contrast, one benefit per screenshot, and paid labels for Pro-only features.
For subscription apps, the paywall screenshot should show Start 14-day free trial and the check-mark No payment due now reassurance only when the app has a real introductory offer.
